title: Longitudinal Wave Animation
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating how particles in a longitudinal wave move parallel to the wave propagation direction. Shows compressions and rarefactions with adjustable amplitude, speed, and wavelength.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: waves
sound
physics
longitudinal waves
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of longitudinal wave animation
Explore longitudinal wave animation through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of longitudinal wave animation to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on longitudinal wave animation
